text: I. Eligibility 1. Applicants must be citizens of a country other than the People's Republic of China. 2. Applicants must be high school diploma holders and under the age of 30. 3. Applicants are in good health both mentally and physically. 4. Applicants must meet minimum language proficiency standards. Chinese-taught programs: HSK level 4≥210 scores (valid for two years). There are no Chinese language proficiency requirements for the applicants of English-taught programs. English-taught programs: TOEFL≥78 scores, IELTS≥6.0 scores, or equivalent English language proficiency certificates.
